# Summary

_What does this change do, in one or two sentences?_

## Type of change

- [ ] `feat` — user-visible new capability
- [ ] `fix` — bug fix in a script or notebook
- [ ] `docs` — documentation only
- [ ] `chore` — tooling, config, deps
- [ ] `test` — test additions
- [ ] `ci` — GitHub Actions
- [ ] `study` — practice work (solutions, notes, tracker updates)

## Checklist

- [ ] `pytest` passes locally.
- [ ] `ruff check .` passes locally.
- [ ] `ruff format --check .` passes locally.
- [ ] `python scripts/validate_repository.py` passes locally.
- [ ] Any new problem folders have a matching row in
  `tracking/problem_tracker.csv`.
- [ ] No secrets, credentials, or restricted coursework material.
- [ ] No modifications to files under `Data Structures & Algorithms/`
  or `Python For Beginners/`.

## Notes for reviewers

_Anything reviewers should focus on. Delete if not applicable._
